name: SOHRY
source:
One day in the summer of 2k17, two girls and two guys meet as a result of a ridiculous accident. This accident starts a chain of events that will change their lives.

[Translated from [url=https://an-korsh.itch.io/savpics-jam]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2017年夏天的某一日，一场荒唐的意外让两名女孩与两名男孩不期而遇。这场意外引发了一连串环环相扣的事件，彻底改写了他们的人生。

[译自[url=https://an-korsh.itch.io/savpics-jam]Itch.io[/url]]
